posts.text:
I watched 'The Odyssey' in the cinema this morning. 9am IMAX showing, like a weirdo.

It was alright... Not incredibly amazing as some people are saying and not terrible or annoyingly 'woke' as others have suggested.

Great cinematography with some standout scenes, but some weird dialogue and casting decisions. And I didn't find myself caring about any of the characters all that much. 

It was pretty good. Not a must watch but not bad. I was entertained.
posts.summary: Film balanced, rejects both 'woke' and anti-woke extremes
